decisions.reason: This second-generation general interior luminaire is a refresh of the core business the firm is promoting, and nothing suggests it is falling short of aspirations.
The firm presents this microprismatic pendant as a flagship of its strategic direction, so it stays committed to it while results are still developing.

Dropping the naval lighting line signals a shortfall in the marine niche, and HMI technology is losing ground to LED, so problemistic search points to moving these resources into LED and core development.
The general marine searchlight still serves existing specialist customers at low upkeep, and slack allows carrying it, though the retreat from naval products raises its risk.
